To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the retail sector has to face a double challenge: the first one is to adapt the organisational capacities to the marketing function and the second one is to adapt this function to its own environment.
the implementation of a marketing function in a distribution company can be a complex process that requires time, resources and a lot of efforts to be successful.

the implementation of the marketing function in a retail company is a complex and difficult process that requires a strong will from the top management to change corporate culture and to adapt organisational structure to the new function.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of the marketing function in a company and not with the marketing function itself, which has already been widely described in the literature.
the organisational and cultural factors which influence the implementation of a marketing strategy in a retail company.
the organisational changes that are required in order to implement a marketing strategy and how these changes are influenced by the corporate culture.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the marketing function has been implemented but not exploited in a <customer oriented> way.
the marketing function in the retail sector has not yet reached the level of the other sectors of the industry.
the retail sector is still in a process of change, which is not always easy to implement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the retail companies which have been able to implement a marketing function are those which have been able or able to adapt their corporate culture.
the marketing function has been implemented in the retail sector, but the organisational capacities are not yet fully developed to exploit it in the most efficient way.
the marketing function is a <necessary evil> in the retail sector.
The main takeaway from our work is that
marketing has to be implemented in a company as a whole and not as a department.
the marketing function has to be implemented in the company in a very specific way, which requires an important organisational adaptation.
the implementation of a marketing function in a retail company is not a simple matter.
